title: Temporal-history committed-state hydraulic-view admission

trigger.diagnosis: DYN02 first-window recomposition uses F-CI31 from a temporal-history committed carrier. mod_fmr_process_hydraulic_view_binding currently accepts only exact fmr_b110_physical_state_t through TYPE IS, while fmr_b110_temporal_indicator_state_t is an extension of that type.

allowed_semantics: admit exactly fmr_b110_temporal_indicator_state_t in addition to the already admitted exact physical carrier
extract only inherited hydraulic fields active_nodes, pressure_head, water_content, ponding_depth and groundwater_level
retain fail-closed behavior for all other transaction-state types
forbidden: do not use broad CLASS IS fmr_b110_physical_state_t because that would silently admit fixed-weir, evaporation and other physical-state extensions
qualification: plain physical and temporal-history carriers built from identical hydraulic state produce bit-identical process hydraulic views
